reason: Provides remote SSH workspaces that route file operations and shell commands to a selected host, with local installation and DSH interface patching.

summaries.zh: 通过 SSH 将远程主机目录接入为工作区，并支持远程文件操作、搜索和 shell 命令执行。
summaries.en: Adds SSH-backed remote workspaces with remote file operations, search, editing, and shell command execution.

capabilities: SSH connectivity to user-selected remote hosts
Remote file reading, writing, editing, searching, and globbing
Reading local SSH configuration and using the SSH agent
Installing and applying local plugin and interface patches
